name: sdd-plugin-suite
description: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) plugin suite — core workflows, frontend, backend, and utility skills from planning to implementation.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Core SDD workflow - spec-driven development from planning to implementation. Includes deep-spec, spec-to-task, implementer, feature-implementer, feature-tdd, and spec-test-writer skills.

plugins.name: sdd-frontend
plugins.description: Frontend development skills - UI enhancement, bug fixing, and Playwright-based testing. Includes bug-fix-frontend, feature-e2e-verifier, frontend-enhancement, git-cleanup-playwright-artifacts, and verify-with-playwright-mcp skills.

plugins.name: sdd-utility
plugins.description: Utility skills for session knowledge handoff, spec generation, gap analysis, and AI code quality review. Includes ask-first, buy-before-build, code-slop-review, gap-analysis, glossary-builder, grounded-mode, handoff, handoff-resume, init-feature, and using-glossary skills.

plugins.name: sdd-backend
plugins.description: Backend development skills for API, database, and server-side logic with unit testing. Includes bug-fix-backend, backend-enhancement, and verify-with-curl skills.
